findings.quote: wait there quietly with his force
findings.problem: Greek reads 'ὡς ἐπὶ * πρεπίου μένειν ἐνσχολάσαντα μετὰ τῆς δυνάμεως': there is a gap/corruption marked * before 'πρεπίου', and nothing in the Greek means 'quietly' (ἐνσχολάσαντα = spending time/lingering). The English smooths the gap away.
findings.proposed_fix: wait with his force, passing the time [Greek text defective here: 'as if for … prepion']

units.note: The Greek at this point is corrupt; the fix only marks the gap and does not restore the text.

Greek contains the lemma 'Ἀγάθυρνα, πόλις Σικελίας, ὡς Πολύβιος ἀνάτῃ' (Agathyrna, a city of Sicily, as Polybius in Book 10/11 [sic, ἀνάτῃ corrupt]) which the English omits entirely; outside the listed error classes, flagged for the editor only.

findings.quote: left no city untouched by the name and reality of slavery
findings.problem: Greek: 'οὐδεμίαν πόλιν ἄμοιρον ἐποίησαν τοῦ τῆς δουλείας ὀνόματος' - only 'the name of slavery'; 'and reality' is not in the Greek.
findings.proposed_fix: left no city without a share in the name of slavery

findings.quote: For the Aetolians alone among the Greeks stood face to face with Antipater
findings.problem: The Greek of the preceding sentence ends in an ellipsis ('παρασπόνδησις...') and this sentence begins with 'γάρ', so a gap in the source precedes it; the English reads on as if continuous.
findings.proposed_fix: [Greek text lost here.] For the Aetolians alone among the Greeks stood face to face with Antipater
